- Health data syncs only after a separate opt-in.
- Backups are optional: an encrypted backup with its own secret, readable exports per area, or an Export everything (a readable ZIP).
- ZIGoals runs no AI service itself. I'm your own AI, connected through your key, a local model or OpenRouter, and ZIGoals sees none of this conversation. Every answer is labelled as coming from your provider, not from ZIGoals.

And on the Alpha, it runs on a test network, so nothing here is real money.
